title: Bitwise XOR of All Pairings
summary: Given two 0-indexed arrays, nums1 and nums2, consisting of non-negative integers, compute the bitwise XOR of all possible pairings between elements from nums1 and nums2.
statement: Given two 0-indexed arrays, nums1 and nums2, consisting of non-negative integers, compute the bitwise XOR of all possible pairings between elements from nums1 and nums2. Return the resulting bitwise XOR value.
constraints: Form nums1[i] XOR nums2[j] for every cross-array index pair.
Return the XOR of all those pair values.
Repeated values and occurrences retain their index multiplicity.
hints: Each nums1 value occurs once for every nums2 position, and vice versa.
A value repeated an even number of times cancels under XOR; an odd count leaves one copy.
XOR nums1 only when len(nums2) is odd, and XOR nums2 only when len(nums1) is odd.
Expanding every pair XOR and regrouping identical source occurrences proves exactly those parity contributions.
editorial: Expanding every pair XOR and regrouping identical source occurrences proves exactly those parity contributions.

tests.explanation: Each nums1 value appears four times and cancels; each nums2 value appears three times and contributes, yielding thirteen.
Every source value appears an even number of times across pairings, so the result is zero.
